summary: Stop asking AI to summarise. Ask for decisions, actions, open questions and risks instead.
body: Stop asking AI to summarise. Ask for decisions, actions, open questions and risks instead.

A summary is just a shorter wall of text. These two prompts get you what was decided, who does what by when, and what's still unclear.
Works in Claude (claude.ai) or ChatGPT (chatgpt.com) on email threads, meeting transcripts, Slack threads, reports and contracts.
